story_description: As a developer, I need Blaze to communicate with Codex CLI via JSON-RPC over stdio so that all Codex protocol methods and events are supported.
task_description: Implement support for Codex review mode where the agent pauses for human review. Handle the review/start RPC method to initiate review, parse enteredReviewMode and exitedReviewMode events to track state, and integrate with turn lifecycle so review pauses the active turn until user approves or cancels.
atom_description: CodexStdioAdapter gains review mode support. The review/start JSON-RPC method initiates review pause. The enteredReviewMode event transitions session to review state with proposed changes. The exitedReviewMode event resumes normal execution. UI state tracks isInReviewMode to show review panel. Turn lifecycle is paused during review: no new events emitted until user action. User can approve (resume execution) or cancel (abort turn). ReviewModeState enum captures pending changes and context for UI display.
problem_statement: Codex CLI has a review mode feature where the agent pauses execution to allow human review of proposed changes before proceeding. Without handling this protocol, Blaze cannot support interactive approval workflows that are core to safe AI coding assistance. The review/start RPC initiates review, enteredReviewMode signals pause with pending changes, and exitedReviewMode signals resumption. These must integrate cleanly with existing turn lifecycle.

event_contracts: enteredReviewMode JSON-RPC event: {method: enteredReviewMode, params: {reviewId: string, pendingChanges: array, reason: string}}
exitedReviewMode JSON-RPC event: {method: exitedReviewMode, params: {reviewId: string, outcome: approved|cancelled}}
review/approve JSON-RPC request: {jsonrpc: 2.0, method: review/approve, params: {reviewId: string}, id: number}
review/cancel JSON-RPC request: {jsonrpc: 2.0, method: review/cancel, params: {reviewId: string}, id: number}
ui_states: Session.isInReviewMode == false: Normal execution, no review panel visible

Review cancelled: Turn aborted, error message shown
ui_interactions: User clicks Approve button: Calls CodexStdioAdapter.sendReviewApproval, waits for exitedReviewMode
User clicks Cancel button: Calls CodexStdioAdapter.sendReviewCancellation, waits for exitedReviewMode

edge_cases: enteredReviewMode received with empty pendingChanges array (show reason only)
exitedReviewMode received without prior enteredReviewMode (ignore, log warning)
Review approval sent but exitedReviewMode never received (timeout after 30s)
Session ends while in review mode (cleanup review state, cancel pending)
Two enteredReviewMode events received back-to-back (second replaces first, log warning)
Review JSON-RPC request fails with network error (retry once, then show error)
ReviewModeContext.pendingChanges contains binary files (show file list only, no diff)
failure_modes: JSON-RPC review/approve fails: Log error, show retry button in UI, keep review state active
JSON-RPC review/cancel fails: Log error, show retry button in UI, keep review state active
enteredReviewMode payload malformed: Log parse error, emit generic review event with unknown reason
exitedReviewMode payload malformed: Log parse error, assume cancelled, clear review state
Event buffer overflows during long review: Drop oldest events, log warning
Codex process dies during review: Emit sessionEnded with error, clear review state

risk_register.blast_radius: Review mode affects Codex sessions only. Claude sessions unaffected. If review parsing fails, worst case is review events are ignored and user must manually manage Codex.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If review mode causes issues, disable review event handling in CodexEventMapper (treat as unknown events). Users can still use Codex but without in-app review approval - they would need to approve in terminal. Feature flag codex_review_enabled can gate this.
